source_hash_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 file bytes with CRLF normalized to LF; source files are not rewritten

analysis_contract.unit: query; 60 queries nested in 4 fixed documents; one generation per query-condition
analysis_contract.factor_D: CAD; statsmodels formula reserves name C
analysis_contract.quality: separate H x CAD within S0 and S1 evaluation protocols; no causal SCD quality ANOVA
analysis_contract.missing: complete queries per endpoint and tested condition set, no imputation
analysis_contract.multiplicity: revision-time exploratory Holm families: 24 quality factorial tests; 7 per generation endpoint; 4 simple contrasts per HyDE/CAD; 2 SCD language contrasts
analysis_contract.preregistration: No claim that revision-time ANOVA/multiplicity choices were preregistered
analysis_contract.zero_variance: t/F/p/dz undefined and explicitly null, never substituted with zero or p=1
analysis_contract.sensitivity: 100000 query-level sign flips, Wilcoxon for paired contrasts, leave-one-document-out means; 4 documents limit population inference

zero_denominator_answers.existing_rule: existing korean_ratio returns 0; not a new imputation
